:::{#prp-complement-set-difference}
#### The complement of an event is a set difference

For any [event](#def-event) $A$,
its [complement](#def-complement) $\neg A$ is the
[set difference](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mcs/chapters/sets.html#def-set-difference)
$\setdiff{\samplespace}{A}$:

$$\neg A = \setdiff{\samplespace}{A}$$

:::

::: proof

$$
\ba
\neg A
&= \setbuild{\omega \in \samplespace}{\omega \notin A}
&& \text{(definition of the complement)} \\
&= \setdiff{\samplespace}{A}
&& \text{(definition of the set difference)}
\ea
$$

:::
